description.text: Startups are building the critical technologies that will define the next decade—but today, 90% of them never make it past the starting line.

targetApplicants.text: Startups are building the critical technologies that will define our future economy, but 90% of them never make it to market. Newlab unblocks commercialization for critical technology startups through infrastructure, projects, and capital in the geographies focused on rapid industrialization; so the right ideas don’t just survive, they scale.
